notes:
Added:
- Clear All on the Concat Videos list (every other batch tool and Download Video already had it).
- Delete All in Super Live Stream: removes the threads currently shown (respects the search box) and keeps any thread that is running or waiting for its scheduled start.
- Delete All in Basic Live Stream's Saved Scripts tab (respects the search box).
- A confirmation dialog before every destructive action: Clear All on all file tables and on a thread's input-video list, deleting a Super Live Stream thread (previously deleted instantly), Delete All, deleting Basic Live Stream scripts, and Kill All FFmpeg. Clear All says plainly that files on your computer are not deleted.

Changed:
- Clear All is disabled while a file in that table is processing (Download Video: while any download is queued or running).
- All confirmations share one consistent dialog that always appears on top, including over the Settings window.
- Common button labels (Cancel, Clear All, Delete All) are unified across all six languages.

Fixed:
- Clearing a table in the middle of a batch no longer shows that batch's progress on files added afterwards.
- Concat's "Output Video Name" dialog showed "cancel" instead of a translated Cancel button.
- Auto-update no longer hangs at "Waiting for app to close..." when Close to tray is on; every exit path now really quits, with a 15-second safety net.
- Closing the app stops all running jobs, signs out of the licence seat, and no longer shows a "job done" notification for a batch it cut short.
- The updater waits a bounded time and only ever force-closes this app. On Linux it runs in the background with a log, so the update completes even if no terminal window can be opened.
- Basic Live Stream scripts handle video paths, stream URLs and names containing $ ` ' & % ! ^ correctly; scripts saved by older versions are upgraded automatically on launch.
- Basic Live Stream on Windows: a scheduled start time before 10:00 now fires.
- Release builds now run the full test suite; a failing test blocks the release.
